o.text: From Proto-Turkic *sā(y)- (“to count, to consider”). Cognate with Turkish saymak, Chuvash сума (suma, “to count, consider, honor, respect, read”), etc.
From Proto-Turkic *kaĺčï- (whence also qaşımaq (“to scratch”)). Cognate with Turkish kaşağı.
Borrowed from Classical Persian هَمْدَم (hamdam). By surface analysis, həm- + dəm.
Borrowed from Persian ﻓﻴﺾ ﻳﺎﺏ. Compare Ottoman Turkish ﻓﻴﺾ ﻳﺎﺏ, Uzbek fayzyob.
